title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02)
short_desc: Foundational AWS certification prep: cloud concepts, security, core services and billing.
description: Prepare for the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) exam. The course follows the four official exam domains — Cloud Concepts, Security and Compliance, Cloud Technology and Services, and Billing, Pricing and Support — with study notes, official resources and practice questions.
what_you_learn: Explain the value proposition and benefits of the AWS Cloud | Describe the AWS shared responsibility model | Identify core AWS compute, storage, database and networking services | Understand AWS pricing models, billing tools and support plans
requirements: No prior AWS experience required | Basic IT knowledge is helpful
